key_insight: Depth Pro 2 aims to make monocular depth maps both sharp and stable across video frames, rather than sacrificing one quality for the other. A single network handles images and video at native resolution.
problem_solved: Monocular depth methods commonly trade crisp object boundaries for temporal consistency: single-frame methods favor sharpness, while multi-frame methods favor stability.
method: Train one scalable network to process both individual images and video.
Predict dense metric depth at native image resolution.
Target both sharp depth boundaries and consistent predictions across video frames.
impact: This unified approach could simplify depth-estimation pipelines for applications needing detailed geometry and stable video output. The provided abstract is truncated, so quantitative gains and runtime performance cannot be assessed.
visual_elements: Trade-off diagram contrasting boundary sharpness with temporal consistency, with Depth Pro 2 targeting both.
Pipeline showing an image or video entering one network and producing full-resolution metric depth maps.
Illustrative boundary close-up highlighting crisp object edges in a depth map.
Illustrative sequence of depth maps showing stable predictions across adjacent video frames.
paper_title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
paper_authors: Peiyun Hu, Marko Mihajlovic, Lyndon Duong, Lahav Lipson, Wei Dong
